caseStudies.title: Enterprise RAG Assistant
caseStudies.overview: A modular system connecting corporate knowledge bases with LLMs via RAG. Features asynchronous PDF processing, semantic chunking, and hybrid search with re-ranking to eliminate hallucinations.
caseStudies.challenge: Enterprise knowledge is scattered across PDFs, Confluence, SharePoint, and legacy databases. Teams waste hours searching for answers. Traditional keyword search fails on technical jargon and context-dependent queries.
caseStudies.solution: Built a RAG pipeline with LangChain: document ingestion → semantic chunking (512 tokens, 10% overlap) → embedding with OpenAI text-embedding-3-small → vector storage in pgvector → hybrid search (BM25 + cosine) → cross-encoder re-ranking → LLM synthesis with citations.
approach: Async document processing with Celery + Redis for 99% uptime under load
Semantic chunking preserves context boundaries better than fixed-size splits
Hybrid search (BM25 + vector) catches both exact matches and semantic similarity
Streaming responses with source citations for auditability
caseStudies.results: Deployed to 500+ users across 3 departments. Reduced knowledge lookup time from 15 min to 30 sec. Integrated with Slack and Teams via webhooks.

caseStudies.title: IoT Telemetry Resilient Backend
caseStudies.overview: High-performance platform for massive IoT sensor data streams. Fault-tolerant design with local persistence guaranteeing 99% uptime under concurrent traffic.
caseStudies.challenge: 10,000+ sensors sending telemetry every 5 seconds. Network partitions, broker failures, and traffic spikes cause data loss. Need exactly-once processing with sub-second latency.
caseStudies.solution: Edge buffering with SQLite WAL → MQTT with QoS 1 + persistent sessions → Async ingest (asyncio + aio-pika) → TimescaleDB hypertable with compression → WebSocket push to dashboards.
approach: Local-first architecture: sensors write to edge SQLite, sync when online
MQTT persistent sessions with clean_start=false survive broker restarts
TimescaleDB continuous aggregates for real-time downsampling (1s → 1m → 1h)
Backpressure handling with asyncio.Queue(maxsize=10000) + circuit breaker
Health checks: /ready (DB connected), /live (process alive) for K8s probes
caseStudies.results: Processing 4.3B messages/month across 3 regions. Zero data loss incidents in 18 months. Dashboard latency <100ms for 50 concurrent users.

caseStudies.title: Interactive 3D Analytics Dashboard
caseStudies.overview: Transforms massive tabular datasets into navigable, gamified 3D environments. Drastically reduces analysis time while maintaining stable framerate in the browser.
caseStudies.challenge: Analysts struggle with 100k+ row datasets in 2D tables. Patterns in spatial/temporal data are invisible. Existing BI tools can't render 3D at 60fps with interactivity.
caseStudies.solution: Three.js scene with instanced meshes (100k+ objects at 60fps) → WebGL shaders for color-by-value → WebSocket live updates → React UI with Tailwind → Django REST + PostgreSQL backend.
approach: InstancedMesh for 100k+ objects with single draw call
GPU-driven filtering via shader uniforms (no JS iteration)
Level-of-detail: high-res near camera, low-res far
WebSocket binary protocol (protobuf) for 10x bandwidth reduction
Web Workers for data parsing off main thread
caseStudies.results: 40% reduction in analysis time for non-technical users. Adopted by 3 Fortune 500 clients. Runs on 5-year-old laptops.

settings.marquee: Xlerion is more than just buildings · 50+ murals · community driven · san salvador, el salvador ·
aboutParas: Xlerion is one of the largest social housing complexes in El Salvador: a grid of concrete blocks raised in the seventies for families arriving from the countryside.
Since 2024 local and international artists have been repainting its facades, stairwells and courts alongside the people who live in them.
This site is an interactive flight over that map. Every pin is an intervention, a wall, a story — added from the ground and published live. Drag to move, scroll to zoom, and take your time.
